title: Perfect periodic binary sequences beyond period four
summary: Determine whether any periodic binary sequence of period greater than four has zero autocorrelation at every nonzero shift.

formal_statement.body: For a binary sequence $S=(s_i)$ of least period $N\equiv0\pmod 4$, define $A_S(\tau)=\sum_{i=0}^{N-1}(-1)^{s_{i+\tau}-s_i}$. Prove that $A_S(\tau)=0$ for every $1\le\tau<N$ is impossible whenever $N>4$, or construct one such perfect sequence. Equivalently, settle the nonexistence of circulant Hadamard matrices of order greater than four.

scope.domain: Periodic binary sequences with perfect periodic autocorrelation, equivalently circulant Hadamard matrices
assumptions: $S$ is binary and has least period $N$
Perfect autocorrelation means $A_S(\tau)=0$ for every nonzero shift modulo $N$
scope.unresolved_remainder: A 2023 preprint claims a proof of nonexistence for every N>4, but the complete claim has not received peer-reviewed confirmation and the conjecture continues to be treated as open.

provenance.note: The TIT paper restates a historical conjecture without identifying its original source. Its N>4 existence form is equivalent to Ryser's circulant Hadamard conjecture, but this bounded audit did not confirm the first formulation.

citations.label: Morris, claimed proof of Ryser's circulant Hadamard conjecture

progress.summary: The TIT paper restates the conjecture that no perfect periodic binary sequence exists beyond the period-four case.
A public preprint claims a complete proof of the equivalent circulant Hadamard conjecture; peer-reviewed confirmation remains absent.
